backend/main.mo: Main actor defining all data types (Lead, Service, Project, Payment, UserProfile with AppRole enum, etc.), state management with Maps, and public API methods for CRUD operations with role-based access control using MixinAuthorization and MixinStorage.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old Lead records (without paymentStatus and notes fields) to new Lead records by adding null values for the two new optional fields.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five features related to adding payment status and notes fields to leads, including UI updates in LeadDetailDialog, LeadCard, export utilities, and filtering on LeadsPage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend files including App.tsx with TanStack Router setup, React Query hooks for data management with RBAC guards, pages for dashboard/leads/services/payments, and UI components with role-based access control.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, borders, charts, and sidebar using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Quick Bee AI Growth Engine app with favicon reference and script tag loading the React app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for dashboard, leads, outreach, services, deals, projects, planner, analytics, settings, and payment success/failure pages, all wrapped with AuthGate and RequireRole components for role-based access control.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Revenu: Line chart component displaying revenue trends over time using Recharts, fetching payment data via useGetAllPayments hook and computing trends with computeRevenueTrends utility function.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Servic: Displays a pie chart showing service categories with counts and revenue, using Recharts and agency analytics data. Includes loading, error, and empty states with custom color palette.
frontend/src/components/analytics/TopPer: Renders a horizontal bar chart showing top-performing services by revenue using Recharts. Fetches agency analytics data and displays loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Guards routes by checking Internet Identity authentication or demo session status, redirecting to login if unauthorized. Shows loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to set up their profile with name, email, mobile, agency, and role. Pre-fills email/mobile from stored sign-in identifier if available.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireRole: Role-based access control component that restricts page access based on user role and demo mode. Shows access denied card with required roles if unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/common/BlockedSt: Displays a card with warning icon, title, message, and optional action button for blocked or restricted states.
frontend/src/components/common/ChartBloc: Reusable card wrapper for charts with title header and optional action button in the top-right corner.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Displays an error state card with alert icon, customizable title/message, and optional retry button.
Card component displaying lead summary with status badges, niche icon, location, revenue potential, and owner. Includes button to open detailed lead dialog.
frontend/src/components/common/ProgressB: Progress bar component showing value/max ratio with optional label and percentage display.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeImage: Image component with error handling that displays fallback initials on load failure and shows loading skeleton during image load.
frontend/src/components/common/ServiceNi: Reusable component that renders 3D icons for services or niches with fallback to default icon and text initials using SafeImage.
frontend/src/components/common/StatsCard: Card component displaying a statistic with title, value, optional icon, subtitle, and trend indicator showing percentage change.
frontend/src/components/deals/DealCard.t: Card component displaying deal information including ID, status badge, value in INR, and lead ID with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/deals/DealDialog: Dialog form for creating new deals with fields for value, status selection, and integration with useCreateDeal hook.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportDat: Card component providing export functionality for all app data in multiple formats (CSV, Excel, PDF-ready HTML, RTF) with download handling.
Main layout wrapper with responsive sidebar navigation, mobile menu toggle, demo mode badge, and content area with proper spacing.
frontend/src/components/leads/AddLeadDia: Dialog form for manually adding new leads with fields for name, contact, city, niche, status, revenue potential, and owner.
frontend/src/components/leads/ImportLead: Dialog for bulk importing leads from CSV or Excel files with parsing, validation, error reporting, and success feedback.
frontend/src/components/leads/LeadDetail: A dialog component for viewing and editing lead details with tabs for details/edit views, form fields for lead properties (name, contact, city, niche, status, revenue, payment status, notes), and integration with lead update mutations.
frontend/src/components/nav/FollowUpBadg: A notification badge component that displays follow-ups due today with a bell icon and popover list, though the follow-up date filtering logic is currently a placeholder returning no results.
frontend/src/components/nav/SidebarNav.t: The main sidebar navigation component that displays app logo, navigation items filtered by user role/permissions, demo mode badge, and logout functionality with session clearing.
frontend/src/components/outreach/StartOu: A dialog for recording outreach activities with a message textarea, platform selection, and automatic follow-up date setting (7 days from creation).
frontend/src/components/payments/Checkou: A checkout dialog supporting multiple payment methods (UPI, Razorpay, Stripe) with order creation, auto-scrolling to sections, and Stripe redirect handling for service purchases.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Displays a list of user payments with service names, amounts, status badges, payment methods, and admin-only status update controls using a select dropdown.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Admin-only dialog for configuring Stripe payment integration with secret key and allowed countries. Validates country codes and closes automatically when Stripe is configured.
frontend/src/components/planner/PlannerP: Displays a 30-day planner plan with summary cards showing overall progress, current streak, and days remaining. Lists daily tasks with completion status and highlights today's tasks.
frontend/src/components/projects/Project: Dialog for viewing and updating project details including notes, completion progress, milestones, and file attachments. Displays project status badge and formatted dates.
Dialog for creating or editing projects with service and client selection, notes, and status. Validates user profile and required fields before submission.
frontend/src/components/services/Service: Modal displaying comprehensive service details including price, delivery time, deliverables, requirements, and supported providers with 3D icons. Includes optional checkout button.

A dialog component for creating and editing services with a comprehensive form including fields for name, price, delivery time, descriptions, deliverables, requirements, and supported providers. Handles form submission, validation, and integrates with the backend service API.
frontend/src/components/uploads/Attachme: Displays a list of uploaded file attachments with preview, download, and remove functionality. Supports image previews in a modal dialog and distinguishes between image and document file types.

A file uploader component that allows users to select multiple files, validates them, displays upload progress, and converts them to ExternalBlob objects. Supports common file formats like images, PDFs, and Office documents.
frontend/src/constants/uploadedImages.ts: Centralized mapping of static image asset URLs for branding, platform icons, service illustrations, and team member photos. Uses base-path aware URL generation for production compatibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity login state. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAgencyAnalytics.ts: Fetches aggregated analytics data including leads, deals, outreach activities, services, and projects for agency-wide reporting. Returns empty arrays for unimplemented backend features.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRole.ts: Provides hooks to query the current user's role and admin status from the backend. Gracefully handles unauthorized/guest user scenarios by returning null or false.
frontend/src/hooks/useClientServiceReque: Manages client service requests with hooks for creating requests and fetching them by agency or for all users. Handles request creation with auto-generated IDs and timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks for fetching, saving, and registering user profiles with the backend. Handles profile CRUD operations and invalidates related queries on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeals.ts: Provides React Query hooks for deal management (fetch, create, update, status changes) with role-based access control for managers/admins and demo mode restrictions. Backend implementation is not yet complete, returning empty arrays and logging warnings.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: Custom React hook that debounces a value by delaying updates until a specified delay period (default 300ms) has passed without changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoSession.ts: Manages demo session state with local storage persistence and backend synchronization, providing functions to start/end demo mode and track loading status.
frontend/src/hooks/useExportData.ts: Provides a React Query hook to fetch all exportable data (leads, deals, outreach, services, projects) from the backend, with deals and outreach currently unimplemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeads.ts: Provides React Query hooks for lead management (fetch paginated/all, create, update, import) with role-based access control for managers/admins and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useOutreach.ts: Provides React Query hooks for outreach activity management with role-based access control, but backend implementation is not complete, returning empty arrays and logging warnings.
frontend/src/hooks/usePayments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for payment operations including creating payments, fetching user/all payments, updating payment status, and retrieving payment settings.
frontend/src/hooks/usePaymentSettings.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and update payment settings with admin-only access control and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanner.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing a 30-day planner with daily lead and outreach targets, storing plan data in memory with functions to create plans and update task progress.
frontend/src/hooks/useProjects.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching, creating, updating, and completing projects with role-based access control (Manager/Admin required for mutations) and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a React Query hook to fetch the current user's AppRole from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServices.ts: Exports React Query hooks for managing services (fetch all, add, update status, seed) with admin-only mutations and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionAppRole.ts: Custom hook that manages selected AppRole state synchronized with session storage, providing functions to set and clear the role.
frontend/src/hooks/useSettings.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and update application settings with admin-only access control and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeCheckout.ts: Exports a mutation hook to create Stripe checkout sessions from shopping items, parsing the JSON response to extract the checkout URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeConfiguratio: Provides React Query hooks to check if Stripe is configured and to set Stripe configuration via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space, plus utility classes for page headers, cards, focus states, and teal-green gradient effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Displays agency analytics dashboard with key metrics (revenue, close rate, avg deal value, leads), revenue charts by service and niche, and custom analytics components for trends and top performers.
Page component for client onboarding flow (content truncated in provided snippet).
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying agency analytics including leads, outreach, deals, revenue metrics, charts (bar, pie, line), conversion funnel, and an export data section. Shows a welcome screen with an image when no leads exist.
frontend/src/pages/DealsPage.tsx: Displays deals organized in a kanban-style board with four columns (Open, Proposal Sent, Won, Lost). Includes a button to add new deals via a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LeadsPage.tsx: Paginated leads list with search, filtering by status/niche/payment status, and options to add leads manually or import from CSV/Excel. Clicking a lead opens a detail dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Authentication page offering Internet Identity login or demo mode login (username: 'demo', password: 'demo123') with role selection. Redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/OutreachPage.tsx: Multi-channel outreach tracking page with tabs for Email, WhatsApp, Call, and LinkedIn platforms. Displays outreach activities filtered by selected platform.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure/cancellation page displaying an error message, session ID, and options to retry payment, return to dashboard, or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success confirmation page showing session ID with buttons to view payment history or browse services, and a note about receiving a confirmation email.
frontend/src/pages/PlannerPage.tsx: Displays a 30-day planner page for tracking 3000 outreach goals, showing either a plan view if one exists or a landing page with feature cards and a CTA to create a new plan.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Manages client projects with a grid view showing project cards with status, progress, and client details, plus dialogs for creating/editing projects and viewing project details.
frontend/src/pages/ProposalSharePage.tsx: A placeholder page for future proposal sharing functionality that is not currently registered in the router.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Displays and manages services catalog with search, filtering, status toggling, and ability to seed pre-defined catalog services; includes dialogs for service creation, details viewing, and checkout.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPricingPage.t: Public-facing pricing page displaying categorized service offerings (websites, WhatsApp automation, lead generation, personal branding) with prices in INR and checkout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Tabbed settings page for managing user profile, payment settings (UPI, Razorpay, Stripe), and viewing payment history with role-based access controls.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Optional sign-in page that collects user identifier (email/mobile) before redirecting to Internet Identity authentication, with stored identifier used to prefill profile.
frontend/src/pages/UnauthorizedPage.tsx: React component that displays an access denied page with a shield icon, explanation message, and a button to navigate back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/types/docx.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'docx' library, declaring enums, interfaces, and classes for creating Word documents including paragraphs, tables, borders, and styling options.
frontend/src/types/jspdf-autotable.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'jspdf-autotable' plugin, declaring interfaces for table generation options including cells, columns, styles, and formatting.
frontend/src/types/jspdf.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'jspdf' library, declaring the jsPDF class with methods for creating PDFs including text, fonts, pages, and output formats.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Local TypeScript type definitions for Deal and OutreachActivity interfaces that are not exported from the backend.
frontend/src/types/xlsx.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'xlsx' library, declaring interfaces and utilities for reading, writing, and manipulating Excel workbooks and worksheets.
frontend/src/utils/adminAllowlist.ts: Empty utility file, likely intended for admin user allowlist functionality but currently contains no code.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeReve: Utility function that computes daily revenue trends from payment data, filtering paid payments and grouping them by date for the last 30 days.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeServ: Utility function that groups services by niche/category and calculates count and revenue for each category, sorted by revenue.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeTopP: Utility function that identifies and returns the top 10 services ranked by revenue.
frontend/src/utils/assets/publicAssetUrl: Utility function that generates base-path aware URLs for static assets from the public directory, handling both development and production deployments.
frontend/src/utils/export/download.ts: Utility function that triggers a browser download for a Blob object by creating a temporary anchor element and cleaning up the object URL.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportCsv.ts: Utility that generates CSV exports from ExportData, creating sections for leads, outreach, services, deals, and projects with proper CSV escaping.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportDocx.ts: Utility that generates RTF documents (compatible with Word) from ExportData, creating formatted sections with tables for each data type.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportPdf.ts: Utility that generates HTML documents styled for PDF printing from ExportData, creating formatted tables for leads, outreach, services, deals, and projects.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportSchema.t: Defines export field schemas and formatters for leads, outreach activities, services, deals, and projects, including currency formatting, date conversion, and label mappings for CSV/Excel export.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportXlsx.ts: Generates XLSX files using SpreadsheetML XML format without external dependencies, creating multi-worksheet workbooks with styled headers and properly escaped data cells.
frontend/src/utils/export/filename.ts: Provides utilities to generate timestamped filenames for exports and format human-readable timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/icons/serviceNiche3dI: Maps service types/subtypes and niche values to 3D icon asset URLs with fallback defaults for visual representation across the application.
frontend/src/utils/leads/csv.ts: Parses CSV and Excel files to extract lead data with validation, error reporting, and conversion to Lead objects with required fields (name, contact, city, niche).
frontend/src/utils/rbac.ts: Implements role-based access control (RBAC) defining route permissions for Admin, Manager, Client, and Demo roles with path access validation functions.
Defines a comprehensive catalog of pre-configured services across website, AI automation, and marketing categories with pricing, delivery times, and service types for seeding the database.
frontend/src/utils/services/serviceDetai: Provides utilities to parse and format newline-separated list fields (deliverables, requirements) for service detail forms and validation.
frontend/src/utils/sessionAuth.ts: Manages session storage for user roles and demo mode flags with getters, setters, and clear functions for authentication state persistence.
frontend/src/utils/signInIdentifier.ts: Provides utilities for storing/retrieving sign-in identifiers in sessionStorage, classifying them as email or phone, and comparing identifiers with normalization.
frontend/src/utils/uploads/fileValidatio: Validates uploaded files against allowed types (images, PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX) and enforces a 10MB size limit.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Extracts and manages URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, extended theme utilities, and plugins for typography, animations, and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for a lead management app, listing existing features for payment status tracking, notes, and data export, plus pending feature requests.
